value.name: Authorization
Accept
value.description:
Specifies your preference for the response format.

Supported formats: 
- text/event-stream
- application/json or text/json
- text/plain

value.name: X-Cache-Tolerance
value.description: Sets internal cache tolerance in seconds if this header is specified with a integer.

value.name: X-No-Cache
value.description:
Ignores internal cache if this header is specified with a value.

Equivalent to X-Cache-Tolerance: 0

value.name: X-Respond-With
value.description:
Specifies the (non-default) form of the crawled data you prefer.

Supported formats: 
- markdown
- html
- text
- pageshot
- screenshot
- content
- any combination of the above
- readerlm-v2
- vlm

Default: content

value.name: X-Wait-For-Selector
value.description:
Specifies a CSS selector to wait for the appearance of such an element before returning.

Example: `X-Wait-For-Selector: .content-block`

value.name: X-Target-Selector
value.description:
Specifies a CSS selector for return target instead of the full html.

Implies `X-Wait-For-Selector: (same selector)`

value.name: X-Remove-Selector
value.description:
Specifies a CSS selector to remove elements from the full html.

Example `X-Remove-Selector: nav`

value.name: X-Keep-Img-Data-Url
value.description:
Keep data-url as it instead of transforming them to object-url. (Only applicable when targeting markdown format)

Example `X-Keep-Img-Data-Url: true`

value.name: X-Proxy-Url
value.description:
Specifies your custom proxy if you prefer to use one.

Supported protocols: 
- http
- https
- socks4
- socks5

For authentication, https://user:pass@host:port

value.name: X-Proxy
value.description:
Use a proxy server provided by us.

Optionally specify two-letter country code.

value.name: X-Robots-Txt
value.description:
Load and conform to the respective robot.txt on the target origin.

Optionally specify a bot UA to check against.

value.name: DNT
value.description: When set to 1, prevent the result of this request to be cached in the system.

value.name: X-Set-Cookie
value.description:
Sets cookie(s) to the headless browser for your request. 

Syntax is the same with standard Set-Cookie

value.name: X-With-Generated-Alt
value.description:
Enable automatic alt-text generating for images without an meaningful alt-text.

Note: Does not work when `X-Respond-With` is specified

value.name: X-With-Images-Summary
value.description: Enable dedicated summary section for images on the page.

value.name: X-With-links-Summary
value.description: Enable dedicated summary section for hyper links on the page.

value.name: X-Retain-Links
value.description:
Link retention modes.

Supported modes: 
- all: all links
- none: no links
- text: only link text
- gpt-oss: gpt-oss link citation format `【{id}†.*】`

value.name: X-Retain-Images
value.description:
Image retention modes.

Supported modes: 
- all: all images
- none: no images
- alt: only alt text
- all_p: all images and with generated alt text
- alt_p: only alt text and with generated alt

value.name: X-With-Iframe
value.description: Enable filling iframe contents into main. (violates standards)

value.name: X-With-Shadow-Dom
value.description: Enable filling shadow dom contents into main. (violates standards)

value.name: X-User-Agent
value.description: Override User-Agent.

value.name: X-Timeout
value.description: Specify timeout in seconds. Max 180.

value.name: X-Locale
value.description: Specify browser locale for the page.

value.name: X-Referer
value.description: Specify referer for the page.

value.name: X-Token-Budget
value.description:
Specify a budget in tokens.

If the resulting token cost exceeds the budget, the request is rejected.

Note this parameter is ignored for the search endpoint.

value.name: X-Max-Tokens
value.description: Trim the response content at a maximum number of tokens.

value.name: X-Respond-Timing
value.description:
Explicitly specify the respond timing. One of the following:

- html: directly return unrendered HTML
- visible-content: return immediately when any content becomes available
- mutation-idle: wait for DOM mutations to settle and remain unchanged for at least 0.2s
- resource-idle: wait for no additional resources that would affect page logic and content has SUCCEEDED loading in 0.5s
- media-idle: wait for no additional resources, including media resources, has SUCCEEDED loading in 0.5s
- network-idle: wait for full load of webpage, also known as networkidle0.

value.name: X-Engine
value.description:
Specify the engine to use for crawling.

Supported: browser, direct, cf-browser-rendering

value.name: X-Base
value.description:
Select base modes of relative URLs.

Supported: initial, final

value.name: X-Remove-Overlay
value.description: Specify whether to remove overlay elements from the page.

value.name: X-Markdown-Chunking
value.description:
Opt-in markdown chunking.

- true
- h1
- h2
- h3
- h4
- h5
- structured
- s1
- s2
- s3
- s4
- s5
